title: How to plan a visit to an old age home · AquaTerra
description: How AquaTerra students plan a visit to an old age home in Kolkata: stories and songs first, gifts only after asking the place, a small team and a short day.
h1Lead: how to plan a visit to an
lede: A visit to an old age home is a few hours of stories, songs and small kindnesses with the elders who live there. AquaTerra has made {count} of these visits since {firstYear}, with a small team at each, and this is how a team plans one, from the first call to the write-up.

sections.heading: start with stories and songs
body: The visits were built around time with the elders. The write-ups describe a heartwarming day of stories, songs and smiles with the elders we often forget to listen to, and the first visit in April 2023 was about spending time at the home, fostering respect and warmth for elders.

Plan the first hour around conversation, not around a programme. Bring a few songs you know well, let the residents choose what they want to talk about, and leave room for quiet. A visit that is mostly listening is the kind the write-ups keep describing.

sections.heading: ask the place before you bring anything
body: Some visits brought gifts, warmth and essentials, and one 2023 write-up says students brought joy, gifts and warmth to the residents. What a place can accept is for the place to decide, so our teams suggest asking the staff a few days ahead what is welcome, and bringing only what they agree to.

Visits to the Urban Shelter for the Homeless in 2024 also offered care and essentials, and one of them held interactive sessions alongside the visit. Ask whether a session for children would suit the day before you plan one.

sections.heading: keep the team small and the visit short
body: The visits were run by small teams, between three and seven volunteers. Across {count} visits, {volunteers} volunteer turnouts have gone. Volunteer turnouts count every time someone showed up, so a student who went on several visits counts for each one.
The team arrives, spends its time with the residents, and leaves when the agreed time is up. Some write-ups call the visit a day, so agree the length of it with the place before you go.

sections.heading: where the visits went
body: Most visits went to the Urban Shelter for the Homeless, which the write-ups also describe as an old age home. The first run was from April to June 2023, with {year:2023} visits in that year. There were {year:2024} visits in 2024 and {year:2025} in 2025, and the 2025 visit was at All Bengal Women's Union.
Across {placesCount} places so far, the visits have stayed small. The team's festival work is on a [separate page](/impact/festival-drives).

sections.heading: write it up in plain words
body: Each visit goes on the AquaTerra site as a write-up: the title with the visit's number, the date, the place, how many people came, a short summary, the objective and one key figure. The key figure for these visits is the number of elders the team supported, and it is worth saying in the summary what the day was actually like.
A line that says the team sang and listened with residents at the shelter tells the next team more than a number alone.

learnings: Start with listening: the visits were built around stories and songs, and that is what the write-ups keep coming back to.
Ask the place what is welcome before you bring anything, and bring only what they agree to.
A small team and a short visit is enough: the visits had between three and seven volunteers.
Say in plain words what the day was like, because a count of elders alone does not tell the next team much.

faqs.q: How do you plan a visit to an old age home?
faqs.a: Agree the visit with the place a few days ahead, bring a small team, start with conversation and songs, bring only the gifts the place accepts, and write the visit up on the AquaTerra site. AquaTerra has made {count} visits since {firstYear}.

faqs.q: What do volunteers do on an old age home visit?
faqs.a: Volunteers spend time with residents through stories, songs and smiles, and bring small gifts and essentials when the place agrees. Some visits also ran interactive sessions alongside the visit.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra visit old age homes in Kolkata?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra has made visits to the Urban Shelter for the Homeless, which its write-ups also describe as an old age home, and to All Bengal Women's Union in September 2025. Visits began in April 2023.

faqs.q: Can students join an AquaTerra visit to an old age home?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra is student-run and its members are aged 14 to 19. To join, sign in with Google and wait for approval, then take part in the next visit with a team.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra take donations for these visits?
faqs.a: AquaTerra takes no monetary donations and is self-funded through its own student-run events. The visits are paid for that way, and gifts are brought only when the place agrees to them.
